texts.preamble: Moeenul Haq Ibrahimbhai Kureshi vs The Commissioner, Food Safety Food And ... on 8 August, 2023 Author: Vaibhavi D. Nanavati Bench: Vaibhavi D. Nanavati Neutral C C/Sca/6608/2023 Order
texts.facts: By way of present writ-application, the writ-applicants herein have prayed for the following reliefs :- "(A) Admit this petition. (B) Pass appropriate writ, order and/or directions upon the Moeenul Haq Ibrahimbhai Kureshi vs The Commissioner, Food Safety Food And ... on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13930948/ 1 respondent authorities and be pleased to quash and [LEAKAGE_MASK] the action and decision of the Dabhoi Nagarpalika authorities of 'applying seals to the respective shops of the petitioners' as per the details of the details of the shops of the petitioners mentioned in tabular-form statement (ANNEXURE-A) and the action of the respondent authorities of applying seals to the shops of the petitioners and restraining the petitioners from NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined doing business sale of mutton/meat/chicken the respective shops, that too the said action of the authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing their retail business of sale of chicken/ meat/mutton may kindly be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK] as the same is illegal, illogical, arbitrary, discriminatory, violative of Article 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and is violative of principles of natural justice and therefore the said action of respondent authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing business of sale of Chicken/meat/mutton may kindly be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK], and the communication / notices dated 08/02/2023 (ANNEXURE-D) may kindly be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK] as the same are illegal, illogical, arbitrary, discriminatory, violative of Article 14, 19 and 21 of the Constitution of India and is violative of principles of natural justice; and therefore the action of the respondent authorities of applying seals and restraining the petitioners from doing business of sale of chicken/meant/mutton through their shops, and the same is in breach of principles of natural Justice and therefore also the same may kindly be [LEAKAGE_MASK] and [LEAKAGE_MASK] and the respondents may kindly be directed to open the seals applied on the shops of the petitioners and the petitioners may kindly be allowed to do their business through their respective shops, situated in near Khatkivaad, Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town. (C) By way of interim order be pleased to direct the NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined respondent authorities to make-open the seals applied to the respective shops of the petitioners as per the details mentioned in the tabular form statement annexed at ANNEXURE-A, and respondents may kindly be directed to allow the petitioners to do their business of sale of meat/ chicken/mutton through their shops situated in near Khatkivaad, Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town, pending admission and final hearing of the present petition. (D) By way of interim order be pleased to direct the respondent authorities to do their lawful business of selling meat/chicken/mutton through their respective shops, as per tabular form statement annexed to the present petition as ANNEXURE-A, pending admission and final hearing of the present petition. (E) Be pleased to pass such orders as thought fit in the interest of justice." 2. Heard Mr. N. K. Majmudar, the learned advocate appearing for the writ-applicants, Ms. Bhavna D. Acharya, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent No.4 and Ms. Dharitri Pancholi, the learned advocate appearing for the respondent No.6. 3. The writ-applicants herein are a group of persons NEUTRAL CITATION C/SCA/6608/2023 ORDER DATED: 08/08/2023 undefined carrying out business of selling live poultry and mutton slaughtered in government dedicated slaughter house since past two decades situated near Khatkivaad, Near Masjid in Dabhoi Town. It is the case of the writ-applicants herein that the writ-applicants herein are in receipt of valid license issued by the respondent Nos. 2 to 4 vide Moeenul Haq Ibrahimbhai Kureshi vs The Commissioner, Food Safety Food And ... on 8 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13930948/ 2 various certificates to carry on the business of poultry selling and selling slaughtered mutton. The writ-applicants herein have placed reliance on the said license, which is produced at Annexure "B". 4. The petitioners herein are constrained to approach this Court because of issuance of show-cause notice by respondent Nos.3 and 4, which is duly produced at Annexure "D", under the provisions of Food Safety and Standards (Licensing And Registration of Food Businesses), Regulations, 2011.
texts.arguments: 5. Learned advocates appearing for the respective parties have jointly submitted that the reliefs, as prayed for by the writ-applicants herein, would be governed by the order dated 11.04.2023 passed by the Division Bench in Civil Application (For Direction) No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications.
texts.respondent_arguments: 5. Learned advocates appearing for the respective parties have jointly submitted that the reliefs, as prayed for by the writ-applicants herein, would be governed by the order dated 11.04.2023 passed by the Division Bench in Civil Application (For Direction) No.10 of 2023 in Writ Petition (PIL) No. 133 of 2021 and connected Civil Applications.
